author: Jarvo
body:
Hello, avicus members,
We are currently recruiting for new members, our team will trial so don't expect to be accepted straight away!  As a team, we have strict guidelines as we want to build a team of good pvpers, with good avicus tactics. We are a new team, which is slowly growing. We expect our team members to be active in the game as well as within discord.  

Team requirements: 
-Must be able to follow directions that are given.
-Must listen while team staff are talking to you.
-Must have some experience as an avicus player.
-Must have discord and a mic.
-Must listen to strats. 
-Must be active

Application Format

Discord:
Previous teams:
Timezone:
Do you meet the requirements (Yes/ No):
Anything else:

Thank you for reading, we look forward to meeting you ;)
